arguments.summary: Credential compromise on host WS-FIN-AP01 attributed to a phishing campaign. Initial access achieved via malicious macro in an email attachment, leading to execution of a Base64-encoded PowerShell payload from Outlook. The payload dropped a DLL in the user's Temp directory, which was executed via rundll32, establishing a C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23 over port 443. Hosts file modification was detected, indicating attempts to block security services. The external IP 185.220.101.42 was linked to prior scanning activity. No lateral movement or data exfiltration observed. The compromised user account CORP\jsmith was secured. Decommissioned asset M2-5200's external reference 203.0.113.40 was reconciled.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 and 198.51.100.23 observed conducting network scans against internal assets (WS-IT-101). Activity blocked by IDS.
User CORP\jsmith opened a malicious email in Outlook, leading to the execution of a malicious macro.
Malicious Base64-encoded PowerShell command executed from within Outlook.exe (PID 4812).
PowerShell payload created a suspicious DLL file 'beacon.dll' in the user's Temp directory.
rundll32.exe executed the downloaded beacon.dll, establishing a process chain.
Hosts file (C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts) was modified, likely to block security services.
Incident response initiated. EDR telemetry confirmed malicious process tree and C2 communication.
Compromised user account CORP\jsmith password reset and MFA enforced. Service account svc_backup reviewed with no signs of compromise.
Firewall rules updated to block all outbound traffic to 198.51.100.23 and 185.220.101.42.
Full EPP scan of WS-FIN-AP01 completed. Malicious files quarantined. Host remediated via Ansible hardening playbook.
Incident closed. Post-incident report generated. Decommissioned asset M2-5200 reference 203.0.113.40 reconciled.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamically generated Cobalt Strike beacon binaries via key API imports and strings"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20240315"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:WHITE"
    strings:
        $s1 = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $s2 = "POST / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $s3 = "Host:" wide ascii
        $x1 = { 6A 00 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 0C } // VirtualAlloc call pattern
        $x2 = { B8 ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 85 C0 75 ?? } // GetProcAddress + conditional call
    condition:
        (uint16(0) == 0x5A4D) and 
        (filesize < 500KB) and 
        all of ($s*) and 
        any of ($x*)
}
